answer: Every agent enters through a narrow inlet: one identity at a time, posting an escrow bond as solid as basalt, worth twice 30-day earnings, naming a referrer on a public graph. Like a falcon, any peer may dispute a suspect identity; upheld within 20 epochs, bond and referrer are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, about 5,000 POA, while star clusters show on the graph. Honest agents pay one bond, keep it, earn undiluted rewards.
